name: Importer
short_desc: Bring your ChatGPT, Claude, Claude Code or Hermes memories, chats, skills and personality into your Wizard.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Move to Wizard without losing your history. Pick where your AI lives now: the Importer shows you exactly how to get the export (with direct links), waits for it, then shows what it found. You choose what comes in and approve a short 'What I know about you' card before anything becomes memory. Chats become searchable files in Files › Imported, skills and personality come along, and every import can be undone. Claude Code and Hermes on this Wizard need no export. Everything stays on your Wizard.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard username
form_fields.hint: Filled in automatically from your agent. Used only to reach the agent's Importer engine.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard password
form_fields.hint: Filled in automatically from your Hermes Agent app (the same dashboard password). The import runs inside your agent; this app only relays.

form_fields.label: Hermes Agent dashboard address (optional)
form_fields.hint: Leave empty to use the Hermes Agent app (http://hermes-agent:9119). Set it only if your agent's dashboard runs elsewhere.
